environment: Cloud Chrome, managed local HTTP preview; desktop plus 390px and 768px same-origin embedded viewports

checks.name: Dark desktop, mobile and tablet reading layout
checks.evidence: Screenshots inspected; readable hierarchy, code/data controls and responsive navigation.

checks.name: Mobile chapter menu
checks.evidence: Open toggles aria-expanded true; choosing Controls and interaction opens its chapter and closes menu.

checks.name: Full-text search across guide/data/source content
checks.evidence: damage_bonus returns relevant results; Snapshot data owner_cottage_a returns the exact complete example.

checks.name: Search link into data record
checks.evidence: Target catalogue is active, target details expands and target content is visible.

checks.name: Catalogue filtering and deep-link recovery
checks.evidence: A nonmatching query hides all 12 examples; global search to owner_cottage_a clears that filter and reveals the requested record.

checks.name: Original source filter and caveat banner
checks.evidence: STRUCTURE_AUTHORING produces one entry; opening it shows its current-plus-history scope banner and chapter contents.

checks.name: Copy code
checks.evidence: Button visibly changed to Copied after the browser copy operation reported success. A separate tool clipboard was empty, so an external clipboard round-trip is not asserted.

checks.name: Download complete JSON
checks.evidence: Click produced a completed browser download for owner_cottage_a.json.

checks.name: No external runtime asset elements
checks.evidence: Read-only DOM query found no external script, stylesheet or image dependency.

limits: No physical Windows keyboard or owner PC browser certification.
Browser interaction used an HTTP preview. file:// independence is additionally checked structurally: all runtime content/styles/scripts/figures are embedded and no runtime fetch is used.
Printing, user clipboard policy and every possible browser configuration were not exhaustively tested.
The game itself was not UI-tested; this record concerns the handbook.
